remarks: You'll enjoy stunning city views from this lovely, modern, light filled corner unit on an upper floor, close to all that downtown Stamford has to offer! The unit has 2 Bedrooms and 1 Bath, an eat-in kitchen with room for a dining table as well. Large living room connecting to a private balcony where you'll enjoy watching sunsets and city views!  Loads of amenities in the building including your own locked storage space, 1 assigned parking space, security, elevators, laundry room, gym and community room in basement. Outdoor pool, clubhouse and playground are all available for you to enjoy! Heat, hot water, cooking gas and basic cable are included in the common charges.
